notes: ACCESS: curl_cffi impersonate='chrome131' (Tier 1 HTTP fetch) worked cleanly for every page; robots.txt has no Claude disallow. DISCOVERY: the homepage links a top-level 'Shop new in' banner to /shop/new-in/shop-all-new-in ('New In' department/group, departmentIdent='new-in', groupIdent='new-in'). Note this department is NOT listed among the 7 top-level departments in sitemap.xml (kitchen-accessories, cookware-and-bakeware, drinkware, electricals, knives-scissors, special-offers, tableware-dining) - it exists and is reachable via direct nav link but is excluded from the sitemap file itself; verified live by opening it directly rather than relying on the sitemap. GENUINE SUB-STRUCTURE FOUND: the New In page itself renders a category-menu filter-tile row with two genuine child listings: 'New in accessories' (/shop/new-in/new-accessories, categoryIdent='new-accessories') and 'New in tableware' (/shop/new-in/new-tableware, categoryIdent='new-tableware') - both independently opened and confirmed as real filtered PLPs (own h1, own totalProducts counter, own categoryIdent) nested under the New In parent group, so recorded as parent + 2 children per the shared engine's grouping convention. The two children's counts (8 + 101 = 109) do not sum to the parent's total (117) - this is expected/not an error since they are two specific department-tag filters, not an exhaustive partition of the parent (some new items evidently fall outside both 'accessories' and 'tableware' tags, e.g. new cookware/knives/electricals items) - parent qty is still the site's own exhaustive total for /shop/new-in/shop-all-new-in itself. No other New Arrivals-type page exists elsewhere on the site (checked full homepage mega-menu and sitemap.xml case-insensitively for new/just-in/latest/what's-new wording - only the New In department and its two child tiles matched; 'kitchen-scissors-new' in the sitemap is a product-name coincidence, not a New Arrivals category). Site search is a JS/Algolia widget with no URL-addressable results page, so nav was used as primary discovery. SIBLING CHECK: ProCook India was extracted separately in an earlier batch for this project; this UK site's New Arrivals structure was investigated independently, not assumed to mirror India's.
